test_title: PYST 1: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
A sentence is provided in direct speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding indirect speech.

He said, “I am not feeling well today.”

options.text: He said he is not feeling well today.
He said he was not feeling well that day.
He said that | was not feeling well today.
He told that he not feeling well.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Direct Speech:** He said, “I am not feeling well today.”
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"I" becomes "he"**
 
 
• The first-person pronoun "I" changes to the third-person pronoun "he" to match the speaker.
 
 
 
• **"am not feeling" becomes "was not feeling"**
 
 
• The present continuous tense shifts back one step to the past continuous tense because the reporting verb ("said") is in the past tense.
 
 
 
• **"today" becomes "that day"**
 
 
• Words expressing nearness in time are changed to words expressing distance in reported speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• The quotation marks and the comma are removed.
 
• The conjunction "that" can be used to connect the clauses (e.g., "He said that he..."), but it is optional and often omitted in common usage, as seen in the correct option.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *He said he was not feeling well that day.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** He said he is not feeling well today.

 
 
• Incorrect because the tense ("is") and the time marker ("today") were not backshifted to match the past tense reporting verb.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** He said that | was not feeling well today.
 
 
• Incorrect because it contains a typographical error ("|" instead of a pronoun), fails to change the time marker ("today"), and keeps a first-person perspective instead of shifting to the third person.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** He told that he not feeling well.
 
 
• Incorrect because the reporting verb "told" requires a direct object (e.g., "told me"). Additionally, the auxiliary verb "was" is missing, making it grammatically incomplete.
